verdict.rationale: Inngest's docs state that you write standard TypeScript, Python, or Go functions using an SDK. Steps memoize results, retry independently, and resume from the last successful checkpoint. Community users corroborate that writing jobs 'feels very natural, much much simpler than Temporal', though one notes the TS execution model isn't fully intuitive at first. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that checkpoint/resume works in practice, and evidence of SDK parity across Python and Go beyond the docs' claim.
